item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po'i rgyud las sras rgyud gsang sngags bdud rtsi 'khyil ba
item.coloph: gsang sngags bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'di/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma yis/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud do/ de yi mdun du sgo btsun rgyal ba'i mtshan gyis zhus so//
